brief.question: Build a playable Android (Galaxy A56, landscape touch) real-time strategy game in the style of an epoch-based RTS, as the person asked for 'Empire Earth II on mobile'.
brief.purpose: Original game in the same genre; the target folder only contains a GOG downloader stub and a Lutris script, so no game files or code are available.
constraints: No copying of the original game's name, art or content
brief.done_when: Game builds, --screenshot and --self-test pass, Android export preset present.

findings.statement: The target folder holds no game: only a 520 KB UPX-packed GOG Galaxy downloader stub and a Lutris install script naming EE2.exe and zips/db.zip, which are absent. No unit stats, code or art can be read, so every gameplay number in the rebuild is an estimate.

Decompiled the only program in the folder (UPX-unpacked copy, sha256 c9eb405f…): it is GOG's Galaxy web-installer bootstrapper. Its main routine FUN_0041efe5 logs to InstallerBootstrapper.log, sets product id 1207658844 and the title, checks the Galaxy registry (sub_4084f0/sub_408251), extracts the embedded .NET GalaxyWebInstaller (sub_416105/sub_41fdef) and launches it with CreateProcessW. The only 'speed' values are download speeds (speedBs/Kbs/Mbs); a search for damage, health, attack, epoch, villager, food, wood, stone, gold and unit found no gameplay data. No game rule or number can come from this program.

handoff: Deep-mode decompile done: the target's only program is the UPX-packed GOG Galaxy web installer (unpacked copy in checks/unpacked/; main FUN_0041efe5 @0x41efe5 sets product id 1207658844, checks registry, extracts and launches .NET GalaxyWebInstaller). No gameplay code/data (fnd_2); MECHANICS.md has a Decompilation section; mechanics.json values stay estimated with a looked_in note. All rebuild_check checks pass (mechanics unverified by design). Test modes now disable vsync and have a 150 s watchdog. APK re-exported via app/tools/export_android.sh. Godot chdirs to the project with --path, so relative --self-test/--screenshot paths use $PWD if it exists. Next: real values need the installed game folder (EE2.exe, zips/db.zip).
